behaviors.publisher: Stable controls below the editing workspace; status failure disables only publication. Committed canonical Project2 captured before await; raw fields, gestures and in-between scratch refused before default pointer focus. Setup password has no name/persistence and clears at dispatch, project replacement, close and pagehide. Separate status and request identities. Successful receipt must match captured bytes/hash; returned read/revoke links remain distinct and immutable while newer editor work is kept. Cancel/lost response makes no rollback or automatic replay claim.
behaviors.viewer: Fragment scrub precedes any private request. Exact UUIDv4 plus read OR revoke lower-hex token; unknown/duplicate/overlong fields reject. No credential storage/history/download inclusion. Viewer assets, canvas, frame, playback and export worker are independent. Bounded stream exact Content-Length plus X-Project-SHA256 verified before model/image decoding. Revoke authority never fetches artwork and requires explicit confirmation.
behaviors.localCopy: Save as new local project creates a fresh ProjectLibrary, real read/accept receipt plus bounded media/history preparation, then one new-entry create. A 10-second aggregate deadline and signal retire late native decodes, close assets and close only that owned store. Capacity/corrupt/CAS failure never activates an existing row. Success offers Open local studio without automatic navigation and keeps viewer/downloads. Interrupted write can be uncertain; no automatic create replay.
behaviors.lifecycle: New fragment/pagehide retires fetch/decode/export/native storage and releases owned bitmap/object URLs. Frame PNG captures private render output; GIF uses unchanged shared worker. Publisher status/layout sits below the canvas so asynchronous service copy does not move an owned drawing gesture.
behaviors.wireErrors: All ten actual Motion codes are preserved with browser-local fixed recovery copy; capacity says revoke one, not-found says private link unavailable, forbidden gives deliberate setup re-entry. Server error literals are never echoed and browser imports no server module.
behaviors.transport: Both modes require exact canonical URL.origin and, in a browser, exact location.origin. HTTP loopback port80 omits :80; explicit:80, aliases, noncanonical/zero/oversized ports and foreign origins fail closed.
behaviors.commandDeadline: Publish and revoke bound the entire fetch/stream/receipt/hash exchange to80seconds with a monotonic final check and a child abort signal. The UI caller ownership signal stays live on automatic expiry, so matching catch/finally displays uncertain-completion guidance and unlocks; usercancel/newpage ownership still retires its own work. No retry/replay. Existing10-second read/local-admission deadlines remain unchanged.
